title: Defense of Japan 2025 Reference
relevant_locator: Reference tables on major GSDF equipment, major aircraft, commissioned MSDF ships, and authorized and actual SDF personnel; printed pages 50, 51, and 209.
reliability_notes: Official pre bookmark reference. Equipment and personnel observations are expressly dated 31 March 2025. Aircraft are national property ledger registrations and ship counts are commissioned vessels. The source does not establish 1 September 2025 readiness, availability, basing, deployment, maintenance allocation, or intervening flows.
temporal_proof: The Minister of Defense announced distribution of Defense of Japan 2025 on 15 July 2025. The cited tables identify their observation date as 31 March 2025.
